prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Das Meer", a wild bright sandy beach at the real open sea far outside the city - the first clean nature after the dusty wasteland, seen from above. The large walkable area is a wide band of pale golden sand running across the middle of the image from the left edge to the right edge, soft and smooth with footprints and a few scattered shells, open and uncluttered.
TOP EDGE: low sand dunes covered in green-gold beach grass (marram grass) fringing the whole top of the image.
TOP LEFT: a beach club under construction - the most eye-catching spot - a rough open bar hut built from bleached driftwood, old boat planks and corrugated sheet scraps, a counter made of a surfboard and barrels, half-finished roof, warm string lights (fairy lights) zigzagging between driftwood poles, stacked crates and planks, a saw and paint cans lying around.
Right next to it, TOP CENTER-LEFT: a small raised wooden stage platform made of pallets, with a driftwood frame above it hung with string lights and two old speaker boxes.
CENTER: a fire pit ringed with stones and driftwood log benches around it (unlit, a little smoke).
TOP RIGHT: a flat sandy clearing at the edge of the dunes where vehicles park, tyre tracks in the sand, a rusty old station wagon-sized flat patch (no car drawn), a sun-bleached wooden signpost with arrow shapes only.
RIGHT, lower half: a big round grey boulder on the beach near the waterline, flat-topped like a seat, with a little pile of collected shells and sea glass neatly arranged on top of it.
On the beach: a striped deck chair, a wooden stake with feathers and a ragged pennant stuck in the sand on the left, a bucket, a little pile of shells.
BOTTOM: the turquoise sea, clear and sparkling, gentle white foam waves rolling onto the sand along a curved waterline; shallow water is light turquoise, deeper water dark blue toward the bottom edge.
BOTTOM RIGHT of center: a weathered wooden jetty (pier) on posts leading straight out from the beach into the water, ending in a wider T-shaped platform with a small mooring post and a lifebuoy.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: RIGHT edge, upper part - a sandy dirt track with tyre ruts winding between the dunes out of the image toward the wasteland.
Time: late afternoon going golden, warm sunset light from the left, long soft shadows, sky reflection on the water; this map is bright and warm, NOT a night city - no neon city, no rain, no puddles; only the string lights add a little warm glow.
